title: Unbounded positive constant generators with an attained divisor
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space whose compact opens are closed under binary intersections, $K,C$ abelian sheaves, $\iota:K\to C$ a monomorphism, and $C\simeq\underline{\mathbb Z}$ an isomorphism to the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Assume $K$ admits an epimorphic presentation by a finite coproduct of extensions by zero of the constant integer sheaf on compact opens [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero]. Then there exist finitely many compact opens $A_i$, positive natural labels $c_i$, an epimorphism $g:\bigoplus_i j_{A_i!}\underline{\mathbb Z}\to K$, and sections $s_i\in K(A_i)$ such that the canonical unit of the ith summand maps to $s_i$ and $s_i$ maps to the constant section $c_i$ in $C(A_i)$. For every $x\in\bigcup_i A_i$ there is an active index $i$ such that $c_i$ divides every active label $c_j$. There is no prescribed upper bound on the labels and no stalk bound hypothesis. Empty families are allowed.

source.place: Lemma 0A38, first two proof paragraphs: clopen refinement, positive generators and adjoining gcds; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A38

proof.text: Apply constantSubsheaf_positive_presentation to obtain compact opens A_i, positive labels c_i and component maps f_i with epimorphic coproduct and constant unit images. This is exactly the clopen refinement and sign-normalization step; no divisor property is assumed.

For each nonempty finite subset S, use constantSubsheaf_gcd_component to construct its component on S.inf A with label S.gcd c. Retain all original components and adjoin these new components. Induction on nonempty finsets proves compactness using hqc, without using compactness of X. A positive member in S and Finset.gcd_ne_zero_iff prove the gcd label is positive.

For a point in the enlarged union, the finite set S of original active indices is nonempty, including when the point is witnessed only by an added intersection. The adjoined S-component is active and its gcd divides every original active label by Finset.gcd_dvd. It divides every active adjoined gcd by Finset.dvd_gcd, since such a subset consists of original active indices. Enumerate the sum of original indices and nonempty finite subsets using Fintype.equivFin. Define the new map by Sigma.desc. The old epi factors through the new map by the original-summand injections, so epi_of_epi_fac proves the new map epi. Define each section by evaluation of its component on the canonical unit; Sigma.ι_desc proves the section equation. The component-value equations and the divisor argument prove the other two clauses.

proof_origin.place: First two proof paragraphs. N2 realizes the finite gcd enlargement and epi preservation directly; clopen positive refinement is split off. The section-to-extension helper is reused from the proved quotient-gluing module.

theorem constantSubsheaf_unbounded_normalization
    (X : TopCat.{u}) (K C : Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X) (ι : K ⟶ C) [Mono ι]
    (isoC : C ≅ (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))
    (hqc : ∀ U V : Opens X, IsCompact (U : Set X) → IsCompact (V : Set X) →
      IsCompact ((U ⊓ V : Opens X) : Set X))
    (hgen : ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → Opens X)
      (_ : ∀ i, IsCompact ((U i : Opens X) : Set X)),
      ∃ g : (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (U i)).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (U i)))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) ⟶ K, Epi g) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Opens X) (_ : ∀ i, IsCompact (A i : Set X))
      (c : Fin n → ℕ), (∀ i, 0 < c i) ∧
      ∃ (g : (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (A i)).obj
      ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) ⟶ K), Epi g ∧
        ∃ s : ∀ i, K.obj.obj (op (A i)),
          ( ∀ i,
      (Sigma.ι (fun j => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (A j)).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A j)))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) i ≫ g).hom.app
        (op (A i))
        (abelianOpenExtensionSection (A i)
          ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) (A i) le_rfl
          ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))
            ((Functor.const (Opens ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))ᵒᵖ).obj
              (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))).app
            (op ((Opens.map (A i).inclusion').obj (A i))) (ULift.up 1))) = s i) ∧
          ( ∀ i, (ι ≫ isoC.hom).hom.app (op (A i)) (s i) =
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        ((Functor.const (Opens X)ᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))).app
          (op (A i)) (ULift.up (c i : ℤ))) ∧
          (∀ x : X, x ∈ iSup A →
            ∃ i, x ∈ A i ∧ ∀ j, x ∈ A j → c i ∣ c j)
